pefSystems.name: Pilot R&D Co-Linear Continuous PEF System (250 L/h, 45 kV, 2 Chambers, Grade 2 Ti Electrodes)
pefSystems.classification: Pilot R&D & Process Authority Validation Unit (FDA 21 CFR § 120 / 3-A Sanitary)
pefSystems.description: Precision pilot-scale continuous pulsed electric field system engineered for microbial kinetic modeling, threshold critical field mapping, and organoleptic quality verification under aseptic sanitary conditions.

pefSystems.name: Industrial High-Capacity Co-Axial PEF Pasteurizer (2,500 L/h, 50 kV, 4 Sequential Chambers, Pt-Ir Coated Ti)
pefSystems.classification: High-Throughput Commercial Beverage Pasteurizer (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / EHEDG Doc 35)
pefSystems.electrodeMaterial: Platinum-Iridium Coated Grade 2 Titanium (5 µm Pt-Ir Clad)
pefSystems.description: Continuous commercial liquid processing unit delivering continuous non-thermal microbial reduction for cold-pressed fruit juices, functional beverages, and liquid egg products with integrated inter-stage sanitary cooling.

pefSystems.name: Ultra-Sanitary Continuous Dairy & Colostrum PEF Unit (1,200 L/h, 40 kV, 3 Chambers, RuO2-TiO2 MMO Electrodes)
pefSystems.classification: Bioactive Dairy & Immunoglobulin Preservation Line (3-A 00-01 / USDA-AMS)
pefSystems.electrodeMaterial: Mixed Metal Oxide (RuO2-TiO2 / IrO2 on Titanium Core)
pefSystems.description: Aseptic continuous PEF system specifically calibrated for raw milk, colostrum, and heat-sensitive bioactive whey proteins, maintaining native IgG antibody conformations while achieving target microbial inactivation.

pefSystems.name: Compromised / Cavitating Line (Low Backpressure, Dissolved Micro-Bubbles, Pitted Electrodes & Arc Instability)
pefSystems.classification: Hazardous Operating Condition (Dielectric Arc Breakdown, Metal Leaching & Survival Pathogens)
pefSystems.description: Severely compromised PEF installation experiencing hydraulic cavitation voids, entrapped ambient air, surface electrode pitting with electrochemical Faradaic corrosion, and frequent dielectric plasma arc quenching trips.

liquidMatrices.name: Fresh Navel Orange Juice (Acidic Citrus Matrix, pH 3.8, Pulp 4.5%)
liquidMatrices.description: High-acid fruit juice with natural organic acids (citric, malic). Low pH acts synergistically with electroporation to accelerate bacterial cell death by preventing post-pulse proton pump homeostasis.

liquidMatrices.name: Raw Whole Bovine Milk (Colloidal Emulsion, pH 6.7, Fat 3.8%, Salts)
liquidMatrices.description: Neutral-pH dairy emulsion rich in electrolytes (calcium, potassium, chloride). Fat globules and micellar casein create complex electrical field gradients requiring precise pulse control to avoid localized thermal protein fouling.

liquidMatrices.name: Cold-Pressed Green Juice (Kale, Spinach, Celery, Cucumber, pH 5.6)
liquidMatrices.description: High-conductivity vegetable juice with elevated mineral ash. High conductivity drives higher current draw and rapid Joule heating, requiring high flow velocities and active cooling to maintain non-thermal conditions.

liquidMatrices.name: Liquid Whole Egg (High Protein Viscous Matrix, pH 7.4, Solids 24%)
liquidMatrices.description: Highly heat-sensitive avian protein solution that coagulates at 62°C. PEF enables non-thermal Salmonella inactivation without denaturing albumen or yolk functional whipping properties.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Escherichia coli O157:H7 (Gram-Negative Shiga Toxin-Producing Rod)
targetMicroorganisms.hazardProfile: Severe enterohemorrhagic pathogen capable of causing bloody diarrhea, hemorrhagic colitis, and fatal hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS). Major target of FDA Juice HACCP 5-log rule.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium (Gram-Negative Motile Rod)
targetMicroorganisms.hazardProfile: Leading foodborne pathogen causing severe salmonellosis, gastroenteritis, bacteremia, and enteric fever. Highly susceptible to irreversible electroporation in unpasteurized juices and liquid eggs.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Listeria monocytogenes (Gram-Positive Psychrotrophic Rod)
targetMicroorganisms.hazardProfile: Resistant psychrotrophic pathogen with a thick peptidoglycan cell wall (20-80 nm) and smaller radius, yielding a lower induced potential. Requires higher electric fields (28-35 kV/cm) for irreversible lethal pore rupture.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (Spoilage Yeast / Large Eukaryotic Cell)
targetMicroorganisms.hazardProfile: Primary fermentative beverage spoilage organism causing bottle bloating, alcohol production, and cloudiness. Due to large cell radius (3.8 µm), induced transmembrane voltage is ~4x higher than bacteria, rendering it exceptionally vulnerable to low fields.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Bacillus cereus Bacterial Endospores (Dehydrated Core & Keratin Coat)
targetMicroorganisms.hazardProfile: Endospores possess a dense keratin proteinaceous coat, low internal dielectric water activity (aw < 0.3), and rigid cortex. Extremely recalcitrant to non-thermal PEF alone; requires hurdle combination with preheating to 65°C.
